row.evidence: MediaRadar publishes no pricing (mediaradar.com/pricing is 404; buyers "Speak to a Consultant"), its public help centre covers only Creative Intelligence features, and its Okta OIN app is a password-vaulting (SWA) app; no SSO or SCIM documentation was found.
row.notes: New row. MediaRadar (ad-sales and marketing intelligence; also runs the former Vivvix 360 and Magnifier apps) is quote-only. The Okta OIN entry (last updated 2015) has only SWA ticked, read from the page markup; SAML, OIDC, SCIM and the provisioning features are unticked, so it counts as no SSO and no provisioning. The public Intercom help centre has 17 Creative Intelligence how-to articles and nothing on SSO, users or administration. No developer portal or API reference was found. No pricing, help centre or API reference documents SCIM, so the row stays unknown rather than none.

okta.notes: Only SWA is ticked on the OIN page (cmp-oin-detail__list__item--checked); the generic 'authentication and provisioning capabilities' line is boilerplate.

fallbacks.notes: No public admin, SSO or API documentation; help centre covers product features only.
